title: Hybrid Token Selector based Accelerator for ViTs
problem: Vision Transformers suffer from high computational complexity due to quadratic token processing. Token selection reduces computation but early-layer selection causes significant accuracy degradation, while late-layer selection limits savings.
motivation: ViTs face quadratic complexity bottleneck; efficient token pruning with maintained accuracy is critical for deployment.
method: Hybrid Token Selection (HTS) combines Keypoint-based Token Selection (KTS) in early layers for content-aware pruning with Attention-based Token Selection (ATS) in later layers for attention-aware refinement. Custom hardware modules accelerate both the token selector and ViT backbone.
key_novelty: Multi-layer hybrid token selection combining content-based and attention-based pruning with integrated hardware acceleration.
contributions: Hybrid token selection strategy integrating KTS and ATS across layers
Custom hardware acceleration modules for token selection and ViT inference
35.85% reduction in execution time relative to unoptimized baseline
0.39% accuracy improvement while achieving 6.05% GFLOP reduction
limitations: Evaluation limited to vision domain; applicability to other transformer workloads not explored.
primary_theme: Hardware-accelerated hybrid token selection for Vision Transformers
